hooks.name: Keep tool schema, implementation and prompt in sync
hooks.description: When the agent's tool contract changes, make sure the implementation, the system prompt and the tests still agree.

action.prompt: server/tools/schemas.js (the tool contract between the Bedrock agent and the tool layer) was just saved. Check that every tool whose input or description changed still matches its implementation in server/tools/*.js and the instructions in BASE_PROMPT in server/agent.js. List any mismatch and fix it. Then tell the user to run `npm run test:paths` and `npm run scenarios`. Do not change unrelated files.
